test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Johannes Gutenberg invented the first printing press that could print thousands of __________ a day. This made books cheaper and information __________ widely available.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Johannes Gutenberg invented the first printing press that revolutionized the dissemination of knowledge.
 
• The word "**pages**" fits the context appropriately, as books are made of pages.
 
• The word "**more**" correctly signifies the increased availability of information.
 
• The other options: "**sheet; much**," "**leaf; many**," and "**sides; most**" do not fit the context as accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Johannes Gutenberg invented the first printing press that could print thousands of pages__ a day. This made books cheaper and information __more__ widely available.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sheet**: Refers to a single piece of paper, but doesn’t fit the pluralized context of printed material.
 
• **Leaf**: Refers to a single page of a book, but isn’t commonly used in this context.
 
• **Sides**: Refers to the two faces of a piece of paper, but doesn’t align with the meaning of pages.
